desc:
Welcome to your first night as a babysitter at the Watterson house. It’s your first night babysitting at the Watterson house. Your job sounds simple: feed Anais, play with her, and put her to bed.
But as the night goes on, strange things start to happen…

Can you survive the night and escape the house?
